Third-party dependency notices for shpool 0.11.4

Source: shell-pool/shpool commit 3a1020c74d1ac8eb191270922d834aa452cac816.
This is a conservative superset of upstream Cargo.lock crates, excluding Windows/WASM-only crates. Build/test-only entries do not imply those components are linked. Crate archives were verified against Cargo.lock checksums.
The extension itself is MIT licensed; component licenses remain their own.

Rust standard library: see rust-COPYRIGHT and rust-LICENSE-*; musl: see musl-COPYRIGHT.
